title: Flag customers that need a review
body:
Account management wants a quick flag for customers whose accounts need a manual look.

Add `needs_review(customer_id)` to `parcelo/customers.py`. It returns True when the customer has more than 3 open invoices, or when the total of their open invoices is over 250.00. Otherwise it returns False. (`outstanding_balance` in the same file already totals the open invoices.)

Asking about a customer that does not exist must fail.
